crossRefs.note: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.
Remember, Yahweh, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.
Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Yahweh. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.
Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the insults of the children of Ammon, with which they have reproached my people…

translations.web: You have heard their reproach, Yahweh, and all their plans against me,
translations.bsb: O LORD, You have heard their insults, all their plots against me—
translations.kjv: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD, and all their imaginations
translations.asv: Thou hast heard their reproach, O Jehovah, and all their devices against me,
